name: office-dialog-api
title: Open dialogs in Office Add-ins
shortDescription: Open a number picker from a task pane or ribbon command in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
longDescription: Use the Office Dialog API to open pop-up and iframe dialogs, return a number with messageParent, and handle dialog errors and closure. Share the workflow across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook with unified and add-in-only manifests.
